युप् {c4c} P. (युप्यति)
1 To efface,
blot out.
--2 To trouble.
--3 To make
level or smooth. --Caus. (योपयति)
To destroy, obliterate, blot out.

]
1 A sacrificial post (usually made of
bamboo or Khadira wood) to which
the victim is fastened at the time
of immolation; अपेक्ष्यते साधुजनेन
वैदिकी श्मशानशूलस्य न यूपसत्क्रिया

.
--2 A trophy.
--Comp.
--आहुतिः f. an oblation
at the erection of the sacrificial
post.
--कटकः a wooden ring at
the top of the Yūpa.
--कर्णः that
part of the Yūpa which is sprinkled
[]
with ghee.
--द्रुः, --द्रुप्तः the Khadira
tree.
--ध्वजः the sacrifice
personified.
--लक्ष्यः a bird. (?)
--व्रस्कः
the cutter of the sacrificial post.
